cohort: 1494 women who participated in the Infant Feeding Practices Study II between 2005 and 2007
finding: Women who give birth by cesarean delivery have lower odds of exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge compared with women who give birth vaginally.
mod_finding: The odds of exclusive breastfeeding at hospital discharge were lower among women who gave birth by cesarean delivery compared with women who gave birth vaginally.
